proposals.evidence: Full varṣārātri gives regional barsāt and Gujarati barsād after Prakrit varisāratta; it explicitly records alternative derivation from or crossing with varṣartu. Western varhāt/vorsāt/vəhrāt/voharat/varhaṭ forms fit the conventional family with weakening of s and source voicing/retroflexion preserved. The published alternative and exact local sound history remain unresolved; these links do not claim exclusive descent from varṣārātri. Exact response: voharat.
